reason: Declares billing snapshot observation states and response records. The Cloud billing owner reads and publishes actual balances and entitlement outcomes.

Declares setup session, container status and action policy records. Setup and provisioning services own claim, container and completion transitions.
Declares native billing and account route request and response types. Native route handlers and Cloud billing authorities own admission and settlement.
Declares diagnostic event, failure and step payloads. Diagnostic collectors and runtime publishers own sequencing and retention.
Declares MCP transport interfaces and fixed retry settings. The MCP client owns connection, retry and retirement state.
Declares search result, reputation and image payloads and service interfaces. Search providers and callers own lookup, authorization and result delivery.
Exports generated static template data. The email service selects templates and owns queueing, send attempts and delivery receipts.
Declares push token, message and result shapes and a token size limit. Token registration and delivery services own lifecycle and receipts.
Declares audio generation options, output data and provider interfaces. Provider adapters own request progress and cancellation.
Declares provider messages, tools, request options and response payloads. The inference and provider adapters own dispatch, stream and terminal state.
Declares guild, channel, connection and automation status records. The gateway and automation owners manage connection and workflow transitions.
Declares billing command and evidence shapes. Billing command services own admission, reconciliation and durable writes.
Declares billing provider scope and durable intent records and a provider version constant. Provider effect owners perform dispatch and record outcomes.
Exports the fixed Stripe API version. Provider clients and billing services own requests, retries and settlement.
Declares token kinds, options and crypto status response records. Wallet and billing status handlers own observation and publication.
Declares character and template DTOs. Agent configuration and template services own selection, validation and updates.
Declares gallery item and presentation records. Gallery queries and their storage own item publication and updates.
Declares agent search results and presentation state. Agent repositories and clients own fetching, selection and updates.
Declares Worker bindings, durable stub interfaces and authenticated request context. Worker services and bound Durable Objects own application state and effects.
